name: PDFForge Studio v1.3.2 (Native Rust Edition)
notes: PDFForge Studio v1.3.2: Native macOS traffic-light window controls (Close/Minimize/Zoom on the left with macOS hover symbols) and full macOS WKWebView PDF opening & rendering fixes (pdfforge: CSP support, self-contained Blob PDF.js worker + main-thread cmap/font loading, main-thread WKURLSchemeTask response dispatch, query-param range streaming, Safari-safe canvas path, and graceful PDFium fallback).
